stem.text: A spring is compressed by a mass, as shown.

stem.alt: Two drawings of a vertical spring standing on a surface, labelled before and after; the spring is labelled spring, and in the after drawing a box labelled mass rests on top of the spring.

stem.text: Which statement describes the changes to the energy of the spring when it is compressed by the mass?

A.text: The spring gains both gravitational potential energy and elastic potential energy.

B.text: The spring gains gravitational potential energy and loses elastic potential energy.

C.text: The spring loses both gravitational potential energy and elastic potential energy.

D.text: The spring loses gravitational potential energy and gains elastic potential energy.
